etsy.description:
Talk to yourself the way you would talk to a good friend. 💙

A gentle 30-day self-compassion journal: five minutes a day to notice how you feel, write down what a kind friend would say, and end the day with one small kindness for you.

WHAT'S INSIDE (21 pages)
• How to use this journal
• Day 0: where I am right now
• My kind inner voice: sentences for hard moments
• 30 daily pages (2 per page): feeling scale, what was hard, what a friend would say, one small kindness
• SOS page for hard days (with crisis lines)
• Day 30: looking back + a letter to yourself

This is a self-care tool, not therapy or medical advice.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or at a print shop. For personal use only.
